summary: Apple Sign-In integration verified end-to-end for backend and web frontend. Backend: 26/26 pytest green. New TestAppleAuth class covers POST /api/auth/apple with (a) garbage JWT-shaped token → 401 with detail starting 'Invalid Apple identity token', (b) random non-JWT string → 401 same detail, (c) empty JSON body → 422, (d) empty raw body → 422, (e) .env has APPLE_AUDIENCES='com.emergent.growbygoals.off8vr,host.exp.Exponent'. New TestUserIndexes verified startup migration ran: users.email_1 is sparse=True, unique=False; users.apple_sub_1 is unique=True + sparse=True; users.user_id_1 unique=True. Existing Google auth regression clean: /api/auth/session with invalid session_id → 401; seeded Bearer token works with /api/auth/me, /api/plants/current, /api/goals, /api/stats, /api/daily-quest, /api/weekly-recap and PATCH /api/plants/{id} (note update). Health /api/ returns {'message':'SproutGoals API'}. Frontend: /login renders SproutGoals title, 3 feature cards, and 'Continue with Google' (testID=login-google-button). Apple button (testID=login-apple-wrap) correctly does NOT render on web (gated by Platform.OS==='ios' && appleAvailable). No console errors about missing native module for expo-apple-authentication on web. Token-bypass flow works: seeding user+session in Mongo and injecting sprout_session_token to localStorage redirects root → /garden and loads current plant (seed stage).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth_apple: correctly uses PyJWKClient against Apple JWKS with RS256 + audience list + issuer check; on jwt.PyJWTError raises 401 with prefix 'Invalid Apple identity token' — matches spec.

server.py startup migration correctly drops legacy unique email_1 index if not sparse before recreating it as sparse; apple_sub is unique+sparse — allows Apple users without email and prevents duplicate apple_sub.
Email→apple linking logic in auth_apple looks up by apple_sub first, then falls back to email lookup and back-fills apple_sub — matches the 'same user across Google+Apple by email' requirement.
Apple only-on-first-signin fields are respected: existing email/name are never overwritten with nulls; new values only set when the stored field is missing.

AuthContext.signInWithApple guards Platform.OS !== 'ios' with a throw; login.tsx renders AppleAuthenticationButton only when Platform.OS === 'ios' && appleAvailable → web import of expo-apple-authentication remains a no-op shim.
APPLE_AUDIENCES sourced from env at every request (no module-level cache) — supports runtime rotation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login-screen render, apple-not-on-web, no native module errors, session bypass → garden load)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: pytest fixture creates user_TEST_* + user_sessions per module and tears down. UI test seeded user_TEST_UI_ebf4cad2 + TEST_UI_tok_* — deleted after run (users:1, sessions:1, plants:1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Apple Sign-In endpoint /api/auth/apple, indexes migration, and web-side gating are locked. For future Apple-related tests: cannot exercise a real Apple flow headless — only cover invalid-token / missing-field / env-config paths. To auth-bypass for UI, seed users + user_sessions in mongodb://localhost:27017/test_database with tz-aware UTC datetimes, then window.localStorage.setItem('sprout_session_token', <token>) on /login before navigating to /.
